svg.title: Post-quantum blockchain algorithm map
svg.desc: Scheme families used by 25 blockchain projects (lattice-based, hash-based, multivariate, validity proofs), and public-key and signature sizes for 8 reference parameter sets. Data as of November 27, 2026.
svg.text: Which post-quantum scheme families each project uses, and for what. Validity proofs are shown apart because they don't sign
Reference parameter sets in bytes, on a log scale. These are algorithm encodings, not transaction sizes.

circle.title: UOV-Is, compact public key: public key 66,576 bytes
UOV-Is, compact public key: signature 96 bytes
UOV-Is, expanded public key: public key 412,160 bytes
UOV-Is, expanded public key: signature 96 bytes

svg.text: Key-encapsulation mechanisms such as ML-KEM aren't signatures and aren't shown. Encoding notes for each row, and four more parameter sets, are in
Drawn by scripts/charts.py from data/projects.json and data/signature-sizes.json. Data and chart: CC BY-NC 4.0, credit Balance Zhao.
